lines.en: label yasuspring7:
scene clearnightsky
It’s night again. Which means that-
lines.zh: 又是夜里了。也就是说——

lines.en: Okay. Well, I guess we’re just getting right into things this time then.
lines.zh: 好吧。看来这次我们要直接进正题了。

lines.en: : Hello?
Consider yourself lucky, though. Because I had this whole thing I was about to say about worms and it was going to take a really, really long time.
lines.zh: 不过算你走运。因为我本来有一大段关于虫子的话要说，而且会花上非常、非常长的时间。

lines.en: : Good evening, Sensei. You’re not busy at the moment, are you?
lines.zh: : 晚上好，Sensei。你现在不忙吧？

lines.en: : Not at the moment. Why? Are you looking to get fingered in another alleyway?
lines.zh: : 这会儿不忙。怎么？你想在另一条巷子里被手指伺候了？

lines.en: : Not even slightly.
lines.zh: : 一丝一毫都不想。

lines.en: : I guess that rules out clitoral stimulation too then. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 那看来阴蒂刺激也排除了。什么事？

lines.en: : If you’re through with your perverted antics, I’d like to inform you about a bit of a...situation here at the church.
lines.zh: : 要是你的下流把戏演完了，我想跟你说一下教堂这边的一点……状况。

lines.en: : What, at {i}Yasu’s{/i} church? There’s always a situation there. It’s probably your fault for going.
lines.zh: : 什么，{i}Yasu{/i} 的教堂？那儿向来都有状况。你去那儿本来就是你自己不对。

lines.en: : No, it’s {i}her{/i} fault for making me come to this blasted, disgusting...cathedral of unrepentant confusion! Do you think I {i}want{/i} to be here?!
lines.zh: : 不，是{i}她{/i}的错，是她害我跑到这个该死的、恶心的……满是不知悔改的混乱的大教堂！你以为我{i}想{/i}待在这儿吗？！

lines.en: : No. I think you want {i}me{/i} to be there, though. So I’ll just drop what I’m doing and head over now because I’m so infatuated with you.
lines.zh: : 不想。不过我觉得你想让{i}我{/i}在这儿。所以我现在就放下手头的事过去，因为我对你迷恋得不行。

lines.en: : Thank you. Flattery will get you nowhere, however.
lines.zh: : 谢谢。不过奉承可帮不了你。

lines.en: : It got me into your panties.
lines.zh: : 它可把我送进过你的内裤里。

lines.en: : {i}No,{/i} it did not. The blame there lies entirely in the hands of hormones and the fact that my type is apparently hulking older men. Flattery was just the bridge we took for me to encounter my acceptance of this.
lines.zh: : {i}不{/i}，它没有。那笔账全记在荷尔蒙头上，还有我的菜似乎是魁梧的年长男人这个事实。奉承不过是我们走过的那座桥——通往我对这点的接受。

lines.en: : Got it. So which alley are we meeting in this time?
lines.zh: : 明白了。那这次我们在哪条巷子碰头？

lines.en: : Goodbye. I’ll be waiting outside of the church to give you a more complete briefing of the situation.
lines.zh: : 再见。我会在教堂外面等你，给你一份更完整的状况简报。

lines.en: : You’ll be debriefing me once the “situation” is over too then?
lines.zh: : 等「状况」结束之后，你也会给我「事后简报」咯？

lines.en: : If you’re good, we’ll see. But I wouldn’t get my hopes up because you have never been good a day in your life.
lines.zh: : 要是你表现好，再说。不过我劝你别抱希望，因为你这辈子从来没表现好过。

lines.en: : Fair enough. See you, Touka. And probably Yasu as well since it would be weird for you to be there without her.
lines.zh: : 说得也是。回头见，Touka。大概也能见到 Yasu，毕竟你在那儿而她不在会很奇怪。

lines.en: : Just hurry up and get here, okay?
lines.zh: : 你快点过来，好吗？

lines.en: scene black
So, back to that thing I was saying about worms-
lines.zh: 那么，回到我刚才要说虫子的那件事——

lines.en: Ahh...you don’t care. So, on second thought, let’s talk about God instead.
lines.zh: 啊……你不在乎。那么，再想想，我们还是聊上帝吧。

lines.en: My mother was a believer. And I, at one point, am sure I believed in her.
lines.zh: 我母亲是个信徒。而我，曾经有那么一刻，确信我是信她的。

lines.en: But somewhere between “goodnight” and “moon,” a poison apple fell into my lap and taught me that the sweetest things in life are those determined to kill you.
lines.zh: 但在「晚安」和「月亮」之间的某个地方，一颗毒苹果掉进我怀里，教会了我：生活里最甜的东西，恰恰是那些决心要你命的东西。

lines.en: Ever since then, I have been a masochist — just not the type to harden at the sight of whips or chains.
lines.zh: 从那以后，我成了一个受虐狂——只是不是那种看见鞭子铁链就硬的类型。

lines.en: I’m the kind who speaks before he’s spoken to and only stays quiet at funerals. The kind who gains a feather in one of his wings each time someone passes down their pity or tells me to clean my room.
lines.zh: 我是那种没被搭话就先开口、只在葬礼上才保持安静的人。那种每有人施舍同情、或叫我打扫房间，翅膀上就多长一根羽毛的人。

lines.en: There’s a clock on the wall that stares at me sometimes. It has eyes once the little hand passes the twelve.
lines.zh: 墙上有个钟，有时会盯着我。等短针过了十二，它就长出眼睛。

lines.en: And each time it glances down, I glance back up. I ask it why the ticks feel more like flight than anything else.
lines.zh: 每次它低头看我，我就抬头回看它。我问它，为什么滴答声听上去更像飞行，而不是别的什么。

lines.en: And the clock looks into my eyes and says something like this.
lines.zh: 而那只钟看着我的眼睛，说了这么一番话。

lines.en: scene ayhh17
scene black
scene yasulocked1
: About time you got here. I’ve been waiting for nearly two hours.
lines.zh: : 你可算来了。我等了快两个小时。

lines.en: : {s}I had to bury something on the way{/s} My bad, darling. I am here now to make all of your troubles go away.
lines.zh: : {s}路上得埋点东西{/s}，对不住了，亲爱的。我现在来了，会把你所有的烦恼都解决掉。

lines.en: : Which would be wonderful if I were the one troubled at all. Also, please never call me “darling” again. It’s fine when my mother does it. But with you, the sarcasm is palpable and unsettling.
lines.zh: : 如果我真有烦恼，那倒是好事。还有，请再别叫我「亲爱的」。我母亲这么叫没关系。但换成你，讽刺味浓得刺鼻又让人不安。

lines.en: : So, what’s the deal? Give me this “briefing” you mentioned on the phone.
lines.zh: : 那么，什么情况？给我你在电话里说的那份「简报」吧。

lines.en: : Before that, may I ask you something? When was the last time you saw Ami?
lines.zh: : 在那之前，我能问你一件事吗？你上一次见到 Ami 是什么时候？

lines.en: : Ami? This morning. Why?
lines.zh: : Ami？今天早上。怎么了？

lines.en: : And did she seem normal to you?
lines.zh: : 她看起来正常吗？

lines.en: : I can not remember the last time Ami seemed normal to me in any capacity.
lines.zh: : 我都不记得 Ami 上一次在任何意义上显得正常是什么时候了。

lines.en: : Well,  yes. There is a certain baseline level of insanity we all attribute to her now. But I mean more along the lines of, has she been acting normal “for her?”
lines.zh: : 嗯，也是。现在我们都默认她有某种基准线的疯狂。但我问的是，她有没有表现得像「她自己的正常」？

lines.en: : I...guess? But why? What does Ami have to do with the church? Why is that important right now?
lines.zh: : 我……大概吧？不过为什么？Ami 跟教堂有什么关系？为什么现在这事很重要？

lines.en: : Well, it’s {i}important{/i} because Yasu has locked herself inside of the same prison she intended to make us fornicate in and will not stop rambling about her.
lines.zh: : {i}重要{/i}是因为——Yasu 把自己锁进了她原本打算让我们在里面行淫的那间牢房，而且一直在念叨她，停不下来。

lines.en: : What?...
scene yasulocked2
: It’s been that way for several days, actually. And when the two cross paths at school, Yasu nearly breaks down in tears.
lines.zh: : 其实已经这样好几天了。而且俩人在学校碰面时，Yasu 几乎要哭崩。

lines.en: : Yasu breaks down in tears practically every five minutes and it’s always seemingly at random. That doesn’t mean anything.
lines.zh: : Yasu 差不多每五分钟就哭崩一次，而且看上去总是随机的。这不能说明什么。

lines.en: : While that may be true, this seems...different.
lines.zh: : 话虽如此，但这次看起来……不一样。

lines.en: scene yasulocked3
: And, as the leading expert on Yasu and her mannerisms, I believe you have no choice but to trust my word on this.
lines.zh: : 而作为 Yasu 和她行为举止的权威专家，我认为你别无选择，只能信我这句话。

lines.en: : So either Ami did something to her...{i}said{/i} something to her...or, equally as probable, Yasu dreamt something up and has now scared herself half to death because of it.
lines.zh: : 所以要么 Ami 对她做了什么……对她{i}说了{/i}什么……要么同样可能的是，Yasu 自己臆想出了什么，然后把自己吓了个半死。

lines.en: : All three of these seem equally likely to me, to be honest.
lines.zh: : 说实话，这三种可能性在我看来差不多大。

lines.en: : I mean...Ami {i}does{/i} “mess” with people. But she’d have no reason to do something like that to Yasu. In fact, I don’t think I’ve ever even heard her {i}talk{/i} about Yasu before.
lines.zh: : 我意思是……Ami {i}确实{/i}会「折腾」人。但她没理由对 Yasu 做那种事。事实上，我好像从没听她{i}提过{/i} Yasu。

lines.en: : What’s Yasu saying exactly? Has she told you {i}why{/i} she’s acting that way?
lines.zh: : Yasu 到底在说什么？她告诉你她{i}为什么{/i}这样了吗？

lines.en: : Of course she has. But that doesn’t mean I {i}understand{/i} any of it. But perhaps {i}you{/i} might since the two of you clearly have some sort of...{i}connection.{/i} As difficult as that is for me to say.
lines.zh: : 她当然说了。但那不代表我{i}听懂{/i}了任何一句。不过也许{i}你{/i}能——既然你们两个显然有某种……{i}联系{/i}。虽然这话我说出口挺难受的。

lines.en: : Alright then. Take me to jail. Let’s do this.
lines.zh: : 好。带我去「牢房」吧。来吧。

lines.en: : You’re awfully comfortable saying those words. Have you been practicing them for when your world comes crashing down?
lines.zh: : 你说这话倒是顺口得很。你一直在为你的世界崩塌那天练习这句吗？

lines.en: : Recited them in my head repeatedly that time I was making you cum in public.
lines.zh: : 上回我让你在公共场所高潮的时候，我在脑子里反复念过。

lines.en: scene yasulocked4
: Oh, wonderful. Then you’ll be adequately prepared when I call the police the next time you bring that up.
lines.zh: : 哦，真好。那等你下次再提这事、我报警的时候，你就准备充分了。

lines.en: scene black
Touka struggles to get the doors of the cathedral open, so I lend her a hand and we’re accepted right away.
lines.zh: Touka 费劲地推开大教堂的门，我搭了把手，我们立刻就被接纳了。

lines.en: Mannequins of all shape, size, and color line the stone pews — heads turning as we walk past them in search of the stairs but Touka doesn’t seem to notice.
lines.zh: 各种形状、大小、颜色的人体模型沿着石头长椅排开——我们从它们旁边走过去找楼梯，它们的头跟着转过来，但 Touka 似乎没注意到。

lines.en: I can hear them whisper. But, being conscious enough to know that this is all just in my head, I angle my chin down and contort the puppet strings that control my eyes in an effort to tangle them with Touka’s.
lines.zh: 我能听见它们低语。不过我清醒到知道这一切都在我脑子里，于是我把下巴压低，拧动控制我眼睛的木偶线，努力让它们跟 Touka 的缠在一起。

lines.en: She moves with such elegance. Such grace.
lines.zh: 她动起来那么优雅。那么从容。

lines.en: It feels like she’s floating.
lines.zh: 感觉她在飘。

lines.en: I feel like I’m floating.
lines.zh: 感觉我在飘。

lines.en: scene yasulocked5
: Aaaaand here we are. Good luck. I have aspirin in my bag if you need any.
lines.zh: : 好——啦，我们到了。祝你好运。我包里有阿司匹林，要的话说一声。

lines.en: scene yasulocked6
: As {i}well{/i} as all of Yasu’s medication. Which she has once again stopped taking and surely played absolutely {i}no{/i} part in her current psychotic break. Isn’t that right, Yasu?
lines.zh: : {i}还有{/i} Yasu 所有的药。她又停药了，而这显然跟她现在的精神崩溃{i}一点{/i}关系都没有。对吧，Yasu？

lines.en: : I’m out of time...I’m out of time...
lines.zh: : 我没时间了……我没时间了……

lines.en: : Uhh...Yasu? Is there anything {i}I{/i} can help with? Something Touka can’t, maybe?
lines.zh: : 呃……Yasu？有什么{i}我{/i}能帮上忙的吗？也许是 Touka 帮不了的？

lines.en: scene yasulocked7
: Bed me. Claim me. Pull my legs apart and pierce my body with the stake you keep between your legs.
lines.zh: : 上我。占有我。把我的腿分开，用你夹在两腿之间的那根木桩刺穿我的身体。

lines.en: : Oh, right. I also should have mentioned that she’s been rambling about {i}this{/i} as well. I’ve likely just gotten so used to everyone {i}else{/i} doing it that I forgot.
lines.zh: : 哦对，我还应该提一句，她也一直在念叨{i}这个{/i}。我大概是听{i}别人{/i}念叨惯了，都忘了。

lines.en: : Hold me down by my shoulders and fill me with your salvation. It is the only way to save me now.
lines.zh: : 按住我的肩膀，用你的救赎填满我。这是现在唯一能救我的办法。

lines.en: : Yasu...did Ami say something to you? Was she here?
lines.zh: : Yasu……Ami 跟你说了什么吗？她来过这儿吗？

lines.en: scene yasulocked8
: I am a failure. A worm. And blind just like Him.
lines.zh: : 我是个失败者。一只虫子。而且跟祂一样瞎。

lines.en: : My job is to {i}see{/i} and I have failed even that. Yet {i}she{/i} has seen it all. Things I can’t even describe. Things that even {i}you{/i} have not seen.
lines.zh: : 我的职责是{i}看见{/i}，可我连这个都没做到。而{i}她{/i}全都看见了。那些我甚至无法描述的东西。那些连{i}你{/i}都没见过的东西。

lines.en: : There are more shepherds than sheep in this slaughterhouse. And what does that make me?
lines.zh: : 这间屠宰场里，牧羊人比羊还多。那我算什么？

lines.en: : Bed me. Claim me. {i}Fuck{/i} me. I will sin. I {i}am{/i} sin. Just spare me and I will live out the rest of my days wading through a sea of atonement for chasing this nightmarish dream.
lines.zh: : 上我。占有我。{i}操我{/i}。我愿意犯罪。我{i}就是{/i}罪。只要饶了我，我愿意用余生在一片赎罪的海洋里跋涉，只为追逐这场噩梦般的幻梦。

lines.en: : We are so close and so far all at once. So many left to rot. Feasts for maggots who too will be feasted upon by the few left standing once He comes to claim us all.
lines.zh: : 我们同时又近又远。那么多具身体留着腐烂。成为蛆虫的盛宴，而等祂来把我们全部带走时，那些蛆虫也将成为剩下少数人的盛宴。

lines.en: : Fuck me. Fuck me. {i}Fuck{/i} me. I need the {i}light.{/i}
lines.zh: : 操我。操我。{i}操我{/i}。我需要那道{i}光{/i}。

lines.en: scene yasulocked9

: Yes, so {i}this{/i} is what I’ve been dealing with. She won’t come out. She won’t take her medication. She just lies there lamenting about the end of days, your niece, and the uncharacteristic desire to be bred.
lines.zh: : 对，{i}这{/i}就是我一直在应付的场面。她不肯出来。她不肯吃药。她就躺在那儿哀叹末日、哀叹你女儿，还有那种反常的、想被配种的欲望。

lines.en: : She is my {i}daughter,{/i} Touka. Please stop calling her my niece. {i}Please.{/i}
lines.zh: : 她是我{i}女儿{/i}，Touka。别再叫她我外甥女了。{i}求你了{/i}。

lines.en: : Apologies, but her specific familial role matters very little to me right now when her mere existence has shocked my roommate to her very core.
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过眼下她具体的家庭角色对我来说无关紧要——她的存在本身已经把我室友吓到了骨子里。

lines.en: : Yasu, did Ami do something to you? Can you come out of there and talk to us, please?
lines.zh: : Yasu，Ami 对你做了什么吗？你能从里面出来跟我们说话吗，拜托？

lines.en: scene yasulocked8
: No...This is where I must stay.
lines.zh: : 不……我必须留在这儿。

lines.en: : This is the altar I must be sacrificed upon lest this vessel never earn its shield and everything we know is swallowed whole again.
lines.zh: : 这是我必须被献祭的祭坛，否则这具器皿永远得不到它的盾牌，而我们所知的一切将再次被整个吞没。

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: : Yasu——

lines.en: : I will die either way. But if I die here, at least I will die closer to the arms of God.
lines.zh: : 我横竖都是死。但如果我死在这儿，至少我能死得离上帝的怀抱更近一点。

lines.en: : There {i}is{/i} no death, though. Just another plane, right? You’ve said it yourself a hundred times now.
lines.zh: : 可{i}没有{/i}死亡啊。只是另一个位面，对吧？你自己都说过一百遍了。

lines.en: : Far more than that. It’s a hundred just this month for me.
lines.zh: : 远不止。这个月对我就已经一百遍了。

lines.en: : I was wrong...
lines.zh: : 我错了……

lines.en: : Death is real...and it comes for us. Just like it came for her. Time....and time..and time...and time...and time...{i}again.{/i}
lines.zh: : 死亡是真的……而它正朝我们来。就像它朝她来的时候一样。时间……时间……时间……时间……时间……{i}再一遍{/i}。

lines.en: : So much pain. So much torment. So many {i}boxes.{/i} I can feel the rope tugging again. But it’s in so many directions now. And each way I look, something new has its tendrils wrapped around it.
lines.zh: : 那么多痛。那么多折磨。那么多{i}盒子{/i}。我能感到绳子又在拽了。可现在它朝太多方向拽。而无论我看向哪边，都有新的东西把触须缠在上面。

lines.en: : {size=-2}I am lost within the crowd. So if I wait {i}here,{/i} I can be found. And He will tell me I am loved. That this wasn’t all for nothing. That We are the righteous and everyone else is a name engraved into the left leg of the torii.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}我迷失在人群里。所以如果我在{i}这儿{/i}等，我就能被找到。而祂会告诉我，我是被爱着的。告诉我这一切并非徒劳。告诉我们是正义的，而其他所有人不过是刻在鸟居左腿上的一个名字。{/size}

lines.en: : Or, alternatively, you can get out of that blasted prison cell and I can have someone on staff make you as many ichigo daifuku as you like. That sounds nice, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 或者，换个办法，你可以从那个该死的牢房里出来，我让厨房的人给你做多少草莓大福都行。听起来不错吧？

lines.en: : You shouldn’t be here, Touka...
lines.zh: : 你不该在这儿，Touka……

lines.en: : You shouldn’t see me like this...
lines.zh: : 你不该看到我这个样子……

lines.en: : Take one of the other altars. Wormwood will show you the way. Then Sensei can save {i}you{/i} too. And we can all face the flood together...
lines.zh: : 选别的祭坛吧。Wormwood 会给你指路。然后 Sensei 也能救{i}你{/i}。我们就能一起面对洪水……

lines.en: : But even then...it’s only two of each animal. And one of us will have to be tossed overboard.
lines.zh: : 但即便如此……每种动物也只带了两只。而我们中有一个必须被扔下船。

lines.en: : This isn’t what the angels told me. This isn’t what I’ve seen. But if all of that was not an illusion...then what?
lines.zh: : 这不是天使告诉我的。这不是我看见过的。可如果那些都不是幻觉……那又是什么？

lines.en: : Come...
lines.zh: : 来吧……

lines.en: : Take it...
lines.zh: : 拿去吧……

lines.en: : Take this body and make it yours.
lines.zh: : 把这具身体拿去，让它成为你的。

lines.en: : Yasu, please-
lines.zh: : Yasu，求你了——

lines.en: : Take this flesh and eat it. Take this blood and drink it. Build a home between my fragile legs and christen it with the fruits of your unconscious gift.
lines.zh: : 拿走这肉，吃掉它。拿走这血，喝下它。在我脆弱的双腿之间建一个家，用你无意识的恩赐之果为它施洗。

lines.en: : But even more than that...
lines.zh: : 但比这更重要的是……

lines.en: : Please...make me forget what I saw.
lines.zh: : 求你了……让我忘掉我看见的东西。

lines.en: : For this is a message I can not deliver. There is simply no time.
lines.zh: : 因为这是一条我无法传递的信息。根本没有时间了。

lines.en: scene black
scene yasulocked10
: So, what now? Do you have any experience picking locks? Or should we really just call the police and let them handle this instead?
lines.zh: : 那么，现在怎么办？你有撬锁的经验吗？还是说我们真该报警，交给他们处理？

lines.en: : Yeah, definitely not the police.
lines.zh: : 对，绝对不能报警。

lines.en: : I mean, I’d obviously give you ample time to separate yourself from the situation first. She’s been in here all evening as-is. A few more hours wouldn’t hurt her.
lines.zh: : 我意思是，我当然会给你充足的时间先脱身。她一整晚都待在里面了。再几个小时也伤不着她。

lines.en: : Is there a key somewhere? Maybe we could just-
lines.zh: : 哪儿有钥匙吗？也许我们可以直接——

lines.en: : It’s in there with her. You think I haven’t tried that already?
lines.zh: : 钥匙跟她一起在里面。你以为我没试过吗？

lines.en: : Okay. New plan, then. Go home, Touka.
lines.zh: : 好。那换个新计划。回家吧，Touka。

lines.en: scene yasulocked11
: Go {i}home?!{/i} And what? Leave her alone? Are we trying to {i}starve{/i} her out now? Because there’s not a doubt in my mind her stubbornness will kill her sooner than she caves to {i}hunger.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}回家{/i}？！然后呢？把她一个人留在这儿？我们现在是要把她{i}饿{/i}出来吗？因为我毫不怀疑，她的固执会先要她的命，然后她才会向{i}饥饿{/i}低头。

lines.en: : No. Go home and let {i}me{/i} handle this. You’ve done enough already.
lines.zh: : 不是。回家，让{i}我{/i}来处理。你已经做得够多了。

lines.en: scene yasulocked12
: You wouldn’t.
lines.zh: : 你不会的。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : {i}Akira,{/i} if you are even {i}thinking{/i} what I assume you’re thinking right now, you are out of your fucking {i}mind.{/i} I won’t allow it.
lines.zh: : {i}Akira{/i}，如果你现在脑子里{i}想的{/i}真是我猜的那个，那你他妈是{i}疯了{/i}。我不会允许的。

lines.en: : That’s why I’m trying to separate {i}you{/i} from the situation. You don’t want to-
lines.zh: : 所以我才想把{i}你{/i}从这件事里摘出去。你不会想——

lines.en: scene yasulocked13

: To have my friend lose her virginity in a {i}basement{/i} during a psychotic episode?! You’re damn right, I don’t!  Yasu’s not fit to lose such a thing even {i}normally{/i} and {i}this{/i} is how you want to do it?!
lines.zh: : 想让我的朋友在一次精神崩溃里、在{i}地下室{/i}里失去处女之身？！你说得太对了，我当然不想！Yasu 就算在{i}正常{/i}状态下也不该以这种方式失去它，而你居然想{i}这么{/i}干？！

lines.en: : You’ll jump at {i}any{/i} excuse to sleep with someone, won’t you?! And to top it all off, now {i}I{/i} look like an idiot for thinking you’d be {i}above{/i} taking advantage of this poor girl right now!
lines.zh: : 你{i}什么{/i}借口都能拿来跟人上床，是不是？！最绝的是，我居然还以为你{i}不至于{/i}趁人之危，现在看起来{i}我{/i}就是个傻子！

lines.en: : You’re right. You {i}are{/i} an idiot, Touka. You called a wolf to come check on a caged rabbit and now you’re surprised he’s hungry? That {i}is{/i} on you.
lines.zh: : 你说得对。你{i}就是{/i}个傻子，Touka。你把一头狼叫来查看一只关在笼子里的兔子，现在你惊讶它饿了？那是你自找的。

lines.en: scene yasulocked14
: Wow.
: So that’s really how it’s going to be then?
lines.zh: : 所以你真打算这么干了？

lines.en: : You’re going to do this {i}your{/i} way and let me live with the guilt of what happens next?
lines.zh: : 你要按{i}你的{/i}方式来，然后让我带着接下来发生的事的负罪感活下去？

lines.en: : That’s right.
: Then why should I leave at all and not just foil your little “plan” by remaining here and starving myself beside her?
lines.zh: : 那我凭什么要离开，而不是干脆留在这儿、在她旁边把自己饿死，来搅黄你那点小「计划」？

lines.en: : Because you’re smart.
lines.zh: : 因为你聪明。

lines.en: : I beg your pardon? Is that some sort of threat?
lines.zh: : 你说什么？这是某种威胁吗？

lines.en: : It could be. Or there could be a method to this madness that your maternal instinct is pulling you away from right now.
lines.zh: : 可以算是。也可能这种疯狂里自有章法，只是你那母爱本能正在把你从它旁边拉开。

lines.en: : {i}Maternal{/i} instinct. Again with this nonsense. These instincts are far from maternal. This is common sense, if anything.
lines.zh: : {i}母爱{/i}本能。又来了这套废话。这根本不是什么母性本能。要说的话，这是常识。

lines.en: : Yeah, well, you’ve always had more of that than me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你向来比我多有这东西。

lines.en: : You’re a pig.
lines.zh: : 你是头猪。

lines.en: : I’ll get her out of here. I promise. But it’s not something you’re going to want to be around for.
lines.zh: : 我会把她弄出来的。我保证。但这件事你不会想在场。

lines.en: : If you lay a single finger on her-
lines.zh: : 你要是碰她一根手指——

lines.en: : Touka...I’ve {i}got{/i} this. And if you don’t trust me right now, trust {i}yourself{/i} for trusting me in the first place.
lines.zh: : Touka……我{i}有分寸{/i}。如果你现在不信我，那就信你{i}自己{/i}——信你当初为什么会信我。

lines.en: : This is exactly the problem with wolves. They always {i}look{/i} cute, but they can rip you limb from limb before you know it.
lines.zh: : 狼的问题就在这儿。它们{i}看着{/i}可爱，可你还没反应过来，它们就能把你撕成碎片。

lines.en: : You think I’m going to rip {i}Yasu{/i} limb from limb?
lines.zh: : 你觉得我要把 {i}Yasu{/i} 撕成碎片？

lines.en: : You’re {i}hungry,{/i} aren’t you? There’s a rabbit right there. {i}You{/i} said it. So what animal am I, I wonder?
lines.zh: : 你{i}饿{/i}了，不是吗？兔子就在那儿。{i}你{/i}自己说的。那我是什么动物，我倒想知道？

lines.en: : You’re not. You’re the sun in the background of the scene, slowly descending and letting nature run its course. Then the moon — rising up and keeping watch.
lines.zh: : 你不是动物。你是这幕戏背景里的太阳，缓缓下沉，让天性自行其是。然后是月亮——升起，守望着。

lines.en: : And you’re a pretentious piece of shit who speaks like a romantic despite being the complete antithesis of one.
lines.zh: : 而你是个自以为是的狗东西，说话像个浪漫派，尽管你本身就是浪漫派的反面。

lines.en: : Touka-
lines.zh: : Touka——

lines.en: : I will have your head if harm befalls her. And the only reason I am biting your little {i}hook{/i} right now is because the act of {i}taking{/i} that head would bring me great joy.
lines.zh: : 她要是受了伤害，我要你的脑袋。我现在之所以咬你这个{i}钩{/i}，唯一的原因是——{i}取{/i}你那颗脑袋会让我无比痛快。

lines.en: : You’ll be a better mom than even yours one day.
lines.zh: : 有一天你会是个比你母亲还好的妈妈。

lines.en: : Then here’s hoping my children will grow up better than you.
lines.zh: : 那就祈祷我的孩子会比你长得好吧。

lines.en: scene black
I had a feeling that’s how Touka was going to react. What I {i}didn’t{/i} know, however, was if she was actually going to {i}leave{/i} or not.
lines.zh: 我就知道 Touka 会是这个反应。可我{i}不知道{/i}的是，她到底会不会真的{i}走{/i}。

lines.en: I’m glad she did, though. Because I know she’s just trying to help, but she’s not ever going to think any of Yasu’s ramblings are actually {i}legitimate.{/i}
lines.zh: 不过她走了，我很高兴。因为我知道她只是想帮忙，但她永远不会相信 Yasu 那些胡话有几分{i}是真的{/i}。

lines.en: And I know that {i}I{/i} joke about them sometimes too, but...I do know that {i}she{/i} knows some things.
lines.zh: 而我知道{i}我{/i}有时也拿那些话打趣，但……我确实知道，{i}她{/i}知道一些事。

lines.en: And if any of those things involve Ami or something {i}else{/i} to help me start putting this puzzle together, I need to know them.
lines.zh: 如果那些事里任何一件牵涉 Ami，{i}或者{/i}能帮我开始拼起这幅拼图，我就得知道。

lines.en: Touka can hate me for it if she wants. But it’s what needs to be done.
lines.zh: Touka 想恨我就恨吧。但这是必须做的。

lines.en: scene yasulocked15
: Thanks for letting me in. I like what you’ve done with the place.
lines.zh: : 谢谢让我进来。我喜欢你把这儿布置的样子。

lines.en: : They’re all scared as well. We’re taking shelter from the end of days together.
lines.zh: : 它们也都害怕。我们在一同躲避末日。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : Are you going to have sex with me now?
lines.zh: : 你现在要跟我做爱了吗？

lines.en: : Yasu, do you actually want me to have sex with you? Or are you only asking for this because you’re afraid of something you saw?
lines.zh: : Yasu，你是真的想让我跟你做爱？还是只是因为你害怕自己看见的某个东西，才提出这个要求？

lines.en: : “Afraid” does not begin to describe it. I {i}need{/i} you to penetrate me if I’m to ever leave this cell. I can not face the outside world a second longer knowing I’m without armor.
lines.zh: : 「害怕」根本不足以形容。我{i}必须{/i}让你进入我，我才能离开这间牢房。只要知道自己没有铠甲，我再也无法面对外面的世界，哪怕多一秒。

lines.en: : And what’s {i}on{/i} the outside, Yasu? What happened with Ami that put you in such a...precarious position?
lines.zh: : {i}外面{/i}有什么，Yasu？Ami 跟你之间发生了什么，把你逼到了这么……危险的境地？

lines.en: scene yasulocked16
: She came here...
lines.zh: : 她来过这儿……

lines.en: : Ami did? Why? I didn’t know about that.
lines.zh: : Ami 来过？为什么？我不知道这件事。

lines.en: : To {i}learn.{/i}
lines.zh: : 为了{i}学{/i}。

lines.en: : She spoke of her mother. Of things she both heard and saw when her time was running out.
lines.zh: : 她讲起她母亲。讲起她母亲时日无多时听见和看见的东西。

lines.en: scene yasulocked17
scene yasulocked18
scene yasulocked17
scene yasulocked18
: And then I touched her...
lines.zh: : 然后我碰了她……

lines.en: : Hands can be so strange...can’t they?
lines.zh: : 手这东西，可以很奇怪……不是吗？

lines.en: scene amibus12
scene yasulocked17
scene handsareweird2
scene yasulocked17
scene amihair19
scene yasulocked18
: How much they can hold. How {i}little{/i} of it can be seen by most.
lines.zh: : 它们能装下那么多。而其中能被大多数人看见的又{i}那么少{/i}。

lines.en: : For those of us that {i}do{/i} see, though...
lines.zh: : 可对我们这些{i}看得见{/i}的人来说……

lines.en: : It’s often far...far...{i}far{/i} too much.
lines.zh: : 往往……太……{i}太{/i}多了。

lines.en: scene yasulocked19
: You sure you want to listen to any of this, Aki-kun? Wouldn’t it be, like, {i}way{/i} more fun to tear her panties off and deliver her from evil or whatever?
lines.zh: : 你真要听这些吗，Aki 君？把她的内裤扯下来、把她从邪恶里「解救」出来什么的，不是{i}更{/i}有趣吗？

lines.en: : Yasu...Ami’s mother didn’t appear to you, did she? An older woman who looks just like her?
lines.zh: : Yasu……出现在你面前的不是 Ami 的母亲吧？一个长得跟她很像的年长女人？

lines.en: scene yasulocked20
: Aww, come on! You haunt {i}three{/i} girls and suddenly none of them can be weird without it being your fault anymore?
lines.zh: : 哎呀，别这样！你缠着{i}三个{/i}女孩，结果她们里随便谁表现得奇怪一下，就都不是你的锅了？

lines.en: : I’ve never even opened a door around this one. And I do that just to fuck with people sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我连这姑娘身边的门都没开过。虽然我有时候开个门，纯粹是为了捉弄人。

lines.en: : No...I’ve never seen anyone like that before. This was...this was Ami. Ami and...and something else...
lines.zh: : 不……我从没见过那样的人。那是……那是 Ami。Ami 和……和别的什么……

lines.en: scene yasulocked21
: Something else as in {i}what?{/i} What else did you see?
lines.zh: : 别的什么是指{i}什么{/i}？你还看见了什么？

lines.en: : E...Everything...
: It wasn’t just {i}one{/i} something. It was so many of them! Each more perplexing than the rest! And the deeper it went, the darker they were!
lines.zh: : 不是{i}一个{/i}什么东西。是好多好多！一个比一个费解！而越往深处去，它们越黑！

lines.en: : I could feel them inside of me. {i}Fighting{/i} for me. It was so loud...and nothing I did could stop it! Even He could not lend me His hand for His hands held only slightly more than hers!
lines.zh: : 我能感觉到它们在我体内。为我而{i}战{/i}。太吵了……我做什么都停不下来！连祂都没法向我伸出手，因为祂的手只比她的多捧住一点点！

lines.en: : Or is it Hers?...
lines.zh: : 还是说，是祂的？……

lines.en: : I...I don’t know anymore...
lines.zh: : 我……我不知道了……

lines.en: : And you...got all of this from just touching Ami’s hand?
lines.zh: : 而你……就只是碰了 Ami 的手，就得到这些？

lines.en: : She’s lying. Ami’s not involved in any of this. I died before the curse could reach her.
lines.zh: : 她在撒谎。Ami 跟这些毫无关系。我在诅咒传到她身上之前就死了。

lines.en: scene yasulocked22
: What {i}curse?!{/i} What are you even-
lines.zh: : 什么{i}诅咒{/i}？！你到底在——
